title: Listen: Why is Morocco looming over Spain’s elections?
lede: As Spaniards head to the polls on Sunday, one issue has been gaining prominence in the campaign: Morocco. Both the conservative People's Party, the PP, and the far-right Vox have seized on Spain's relationship with Rabat to attack the current socialist government.
